svg.title: fit — every gate, check and branch in one call
svg.desc: An invalid request, a stale expected head, a missing study question, an unknown revision, a model that cannot execute, a panel that does not bind to it, a failed preflight or an unusable start fails the call. Local studies can place numerical fitting on Modal GPU by configuration while retaining their pinned inputs and local commit path. Compute or transfer failure fails the call, without a local fallback. Otherwise the particle sampler conditions the model; failed convergence checks, specification findings on the conditioned model, unidentified targets and question findings are saved as warnings, and the conditioned model commits unless the branch moved.
